title: Time Travel: A Comprehensive Benchmark to Evaluate LMMs on Historical and Cultural Artifacts

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and comparing the accuracy and contextual appropriateness of LMM-generated descriptions for historical artifacts across 10 distinct geographic and cultural regions (e.g., India, Roman Empire, China, British Isles, Iran, Iraq, Japan, Central America, Greece, Egypt) using text similarity metrics (BLEU, ROUGE-L, METEOR, SPICE, BERTScore) and an LLM-Judge.
